description: russia-colonialism techniques used by "Eternal Peace" with Poland (1686), ATT&CK campaign C0009 (v1.2)
name: "Eternal Peace" with Poland (1686) (C0009)

techniques.comment: The legal codification of the country's split into two parts, with the Right Bank turned into a buffer zone: "Under the terms of the Eternal Peace, the Right Bank remained with Poland... it was agreed and resolved that those places are to remain deserted, as they now are"(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011)(Citation: Мазепа 2007).

The division of spheres of influence behind the Ukrainian ally's back, accompanied by a financial deal for territory: under the 1686 treaty Moscow undertook "to count out one hundred forty-six thousand Muscovite rubles and hand them over to the Commonwealth"(Citation: Сборник грамот и договоров о присоединении царств и областей 1922)(Citation: Мазепа 2007)(Citation: Иван Мазепа и Российская империя. История «предательства» 2011). Ukrainian historiography recorded the deal as an ordinary purchase - Hrushevsky: Muscovy "concluded an eternal accord with Poland (paying, in addition, another 146 thousand rubles for Kyiv)"(Citation: Ілюстрована історія України 1921).

The complete exclusion of the autonomy from participation in international negotiations on the status of its own territories. In the legal partition of Ukrainian lands the opinion of the people themselves was ignored – contemporary Ukrainian historiography assesses the Eternal Peace "as a national tragedy of Ukraine"(Citation: Мазепа 2007).

The diplomatic entrenchment of spiritual expansion: Moscow secured the inclusion in the treaty of an article on the position of the Orthodox in the Commonwealth – the 1686 treaty ordered the Polish side "to inflict no oppression and no coercion toward the Roman faith or the Union"(Citation: Сборник грамот и договоров о присоединении царств и областей 1922) – and arrogated to itself the role of protector of Orthodoxy on Polish lands, relying on the Kyiv metropolitanate already subordinated to Moscow. The treaty also secured an ecclesiastical lever: the Orthodox eparchies in the Commonwealth "according to their spiritual rank and custom, are to receive blessing and ordination from the Metropolitan of Kyiv; and this shall harm none of them in the favor of His Royal Majesty"(Citation: Договор о Вечном мире с Польшей 1686) - while the Kyiv metropolitanate was already subordinated to Moscow.
